note: What a server sends to have a client write a text to its own log. Nothing shows. The header carries zero.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of text follow. A client does not check it against what arrived, and reads no text where it is zero or, taken as signed, below zero.

fields.name: text
fields.note: The text, with no terminating zero. A client looks each word up in its own text and writes the result a line at a time.
